# List (`list`)

Settings sections and rows, rich list items.

Group: Data display. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/data-display';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createList` (types in `dist/web/data-display/list.d.ts`): `ul.mh-list`: rows with a leading icon or avatar, title, subtitle and trailing slot. `--dividers`, `--inset`.

```ts
export function createList(options: ListOptions): ListHandle;

export interface ListOptions {
  items: ListItemOptions[];
  /** Rules between rows (default true). */
  dividers?: boolean;
  /** Rows in a rounded surface, settings style. */
  inset?: boolean;
  /** Accessible name of the list. */
  label?: string;
}

export interface ListHandle {
  el: HTMLUListElement;
  setItems(items: ListItemOptions[]): void;
}

export interface ListItemOptions {
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  /** A leading icon in a soft square. */
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** A leading element instead of the icon (an avatar). */
  leading?: HTMLElement;
  /** Trailing content: a value ("On", "21°") or an element (a badge, a switch on a non-pressable row). */
  trailing?: Child;
  /** Shows a chevron: the row opens something. */
  chevron?: boolean;
  /** Makes the row a button. Don't combine with an interactive `trailing` control. */
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
  /** Makes the row a link. */
  href?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Marks the current row (`aria-current`). */
  current?: boolean;
  tone?: 'default' | 'danger';
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createList, type ListItemOptions } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const lights = [
  { name: 'Kitchen light', on: true },
  { name: 'Hallway', on: false },
  { name: 'Desk lamp', on: true },
];

const rows = (): ListItemOptions[] =>
  lights.map((light) => ({
    title: light.name,
    icon: light.on ? 'lightbulb-on' : 'lightbulb',
    trailing: light.on ? 'On' : 'Off',
    onClick: () => {
      light.on = !light.on;
      list.setItems(rows());
    },
  }));

const list = createList({ label: 'Lights', inset: true, items: rows() });

document.body.append(list.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { List, ListItem } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function ListExample() {
  const [lights, setLights] = useState([
    { name: 'Kitchen light', on: true },
    { name: 'Hallway', on: false },
    { name: 'Desk lamp', on: true },
  ]);
  const toggle = (name: string) => setLights(lights.map((l) => (l.name === name ? { ...l, on: !l.on } : l)));
  return (
    <List label="Lights" inset>
      {lights.map((light) => (
        <ListItem
          key={light.name}
          title={light.name}
          icon={light.on ? 'lightbulb-on' : 'lightbulb'}
          trailing={light.on ? 'On' : 'Off'}
          onClick={() => toggle(light.name)}
        />
      ))}
    </List>
  );
}
```
